entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 3782, Standbuch 1011, Folio: 386r/v, Schreiber: Lorenz Fries
entries.german: Bei 15 Jaren ongeuerlichen hat Eberhart von Rosenberg burg stat vnd ambt Jagsperg fur die bestumpten xxxiiii c fl Jngehabt aber im 1426 Jahre kamnen Hornek von Hornburg vnd Gerhart von Talhaim die löseten [gestrichen: Erhe] Eberharten von Rosenberg seinen pfandschilling ab vnd lihen furter ime B Johannsen noch xvi c fl [Einfügung am Rand: zusammen an summa mach 999 fl] darfur verschribe er inen vnd iren erben ge- S. 386v dachte burg stat vnd ambt Jagsperg allermasen wie Eberhart von Rosberg die hieuor ingehabt hete Recepta in Contractuum Brun fo. 69. Er vergente inen auch am tag Visitationis Marie des genanten 1426 Jars das si vnd ire erben, [gestrichen: derweil si] Jagsperg inheten, das si in dem wildban dartzu gehorug nach wildbret Jagen mochten Recepta in contractum Brun fo. 71 d. Kommentar: Fries gibt keinen Vornamen für Horneck von Hornburg an.
entries.english: For approximately fifteen years Eberhard von Rosenberg had held Schloss, Stadt, and Amt Jagstberg for the agreed 3,400 florins. In 1426 Horneck von Hornburg and Gerhard von Talheim redeemed Eberhard’s pledge and then lent a further 1,600 florins to Johann von Brunn, Bischof,. In return the bishop pledged them and their heirs the aforesaid castle, town, and Amt Jagstberg on the same terms under which Eberhard had held it. The total is noted in the margin as 999 florins. On the Feast of the Visitation of Mary in 1426, he also granted them and their heirs the right to hunt game in the forest while they held Jagstberg. Register of contracts of Brun, fols. 69 and 71d. Editorial note: Fries gives no first name for Horneck von Hornburg.

facts.content: held Schloss, Stadt, and Amt Jagstberg as a pledge for approximately fifteen years before Horneck von Hornburg and Gerhard von Talheim redeemed it from him.
